name: @proofable/mcp
description: Hosted MCP connection for Proofable identity, permissions, and verification.
author: Proofable

scripts.validate:package: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('server.json','utf8'));if(p.version!==s.version)throw new Error('package.json and server.json version mismatch: '+p.version+' vs '+s.version);if(p.description!==s.description)throw new Error('package.json and server.json descriptions must match');if(String(s.description||'').length>100)throw new Error('server.json description must be <=100 chars for MCP Registry');if(s.repository?.url!=='https://github.com/proofable/mcp'||s.repository?.subfolder)throw new Error('server.json must point at the repository root');if(!p.files.includes('LICENSE')||!fs.existsSync('LICENSE'))throw new Error('Apache-2.0 LICENSE must be published');"
scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-template.mjs && node scripts/validate-cursor-schemas.mjs && node scripts/validate-cursor-mcp.mjs && node scripts/validate-universal-manifests.mjs && node scripts/sync-plugin-skills.mjs --check && npm run validate:package
